slides.headline: 6 AI TOOLS *nobody told you about*
slides.body: Everyone posts the same five. These six do things you probably assumed needed expensive software, and most of them are free.
slides.close: Number 3 is the one that *breaks people's brains*.

slides.headline: FIX *terrible audio* IN ONE DROP
slides.body: Adobe Podcast Enhancer takes a recording full of room echo or phone mic mush and hands it back sounding like a studio booth.

slides.headline: SEARCH *what people said* ON YOUTUBE
slides.body: Filmot indexes the spoken words inside more than a billion videos. Type a phrase and it gives you the exact timestamp.
slides.close: filmot.com. You can narrow it to *one specific channel*.

slides.headline: FIND ANY LINE IN *any movie*
slides.body: Playphrase searches film and TV dialogue. Type a sentence and it plays back every scene where someone said it.
slides.close: playphrase.me. *Free, and genuinely a time sink.*

slides.headline: PULL THE MUSIC OFF *any clip*
slides.body: Vocal Remover separates the voice from the background track, so you can keep the part you actually wanted.
slides.close: vocalremover.org. *Runs in the browser, nothing to install.*

slides.headline: SEARCH *every podcast* AT ONCE
slides.body: Dexa lets you ask a question and finds the moment a host actually answered it, across shows you have never listened to.
slides.close: dexa.ai. Stop scrubbing through *two hour episodes*.

slides.headline: MAKE ANIMATIONS WITHOUT *After Effects*
slides.body: Jitter is motion design in a browser. Drag things around, it handles the animation, you export a clean clip.
slides.close: jitter.video. What used to take a designer *takes ten minutes*.

slides.headline: COMMENT *HIDDEN*
slides.body: I will send you all six with the links, plus which ones are completely free.
slides.close: No email needed. Save this and *send it to whoever still pays for this stuff*.
